Does it feel like no matter what you do or how much willpower you muster, you just can’t break through and make progress?
When you feel stuck, consider the ways in which your environment is hindering you. It can be easy to overlook the impact that our surroundings have on our ability to take decisive action and get essential tasks done, but disorder, temptation, distraction, and complexity in one’s environment can get in the way of taking even one step forward.
